dataset.no_datagen_doc58_SS16_1: exp72 generates NO Arabic. The dataset is exp69's Part A, byte-identical and sha-pinned, already V-suite cleared. doc 50 SS5.2's native-speaker gate does not reopen. Stated explicitly because 'nothing changed' is exactly the claim that should be checked.

comparator_targets.note: doc 58 SS3 / SS7.5: exp72 runs NO comparator. The dataset is byte-identical, the features are the same deterministic constants, the splits and fit seed are the same and the fit is deterministic; doc 47 SS14 is the standing reason not to re-run it. The values are imported and asserted == 1.0000, never re-typed.

block_partition.note: doc 58 SS6.3.1 / SS6.3.2. The partition needs NO architectural change: V_A and V_B are disjoint by construction and at T = 2 event 1 draws only from V_A, event 2 only from V_B. The weighted budget is EXACTLY 150.000 only because stage 2 freezes the readout as well (orchestrator ruling 1).

fourier_closure.N_in_double_negative: doc 56 SS7.1 / doc 58 SS7.1, re-run because a rescue arm that silently unwired the CRY would 'rescue' I2 by making it a different instance. Measured on I2: 1.114e-07 (6-dim, MUST close), 8.161e-02 (3-term, MUST fail), 5.017e-02 (9-dim product, MUST fail).

degenerate_entanglement_gate.rule: doc 56 SS7.3: EVERY N-in item's referents must have concurrence >= 0.10 under the eps-map, computed from the closed form on the item's OWN two nouns. The committed diagnostic guarantees the inventory supports this (minimum 0.1898, zero nouns below 0.05 and zero below 0.10). THE GATE IS ASSERTED PER ITEM ANYWAY, because doc 56 SS3's whole lesson is that 'the map should be fine' is not a gate.
degenerate_entanglement_gate.deliberately_NOT_applied_to_N_across: doc 56 SS7.3, registered honestly alongside, and RATIFIED by orchestrator ruling 7: 4 of the 80 E-across casts fall below concurrence 0.10 and are NOT excluded. Applying the gate there would mean DROPPING CASTS FROM A FROZEN DATASET TO MAKE AN ARM LOOK ENTANGLED, which is the opposite of a validity gate. N-across's weak-pair fraction is REPORTED (see `across_validity`), and doc 56 SS6.8's per-item entanglement stratification exists so it can be read post-hoc without a rerun. The per-item PURITY gate is the working validity instrument for that arm.

copy_verification.note: doc 56 SS7.4: with event (3 - q) suppressed and the query fixed to the surviving event, every T = 2 arm reproduces its T = 1 pipeline bit-for-bit. For the ENTANGLED arms this carries extra weight: it proves the CRY and the CZ sit in the INTRO and nowhere else, which is what keeps SS7.1's closure arithmetic valid at T = 2 and what doc 56 SS13 item 2 declines to give up by putting an entangler inside an event block.

trace_parity.quantity: per-wire purity Tr rho^2 of the single-qubit reduced state
trace_parity.note: doc 56 SS15.1, doc 55 SS18.3 verbatim plus exp70's re-pinning: THE INTRO STAGE IS ADDED AS A FOURTH RECORDED POINT, because for N-in and N-across the intro purity is no longer 1 and is the quantity SS7.2 and SS7.3 gate on. The E-in per-wire intro purity is 1 - |sin t1|^2|sin(t2/2)|^2/2 and the E-across value is 1 - (sin tA sin tB)^2/2; both are closed forms, both are asserted, neither is inferred. Descriptive; NO criterion reads the traces. SS15.2's amendment: for the entangled arms the readout RESTORATION TARGET is the INTRO purity, not 1.

shuffle.note: doc 46 SS10.2's floor, per PAIR, keyed on the QUERIED event's agent, at BOTH T -- because doc 58 SS14.4's severed-donor protocol shuffles the T = 1 item set as well, under the SAME seed (the registered SEED LINKAGE). The TRUE bearer rule collapses to chance on the shuffled labels, which is the severance, measured rather than asserted.

failing_directions.note: doc 58 SS7.2 / doc 48 SS10.6. EVERY procedure assertion is fed the input that must make it fail, and the failure is recorded. An assertion that has never been seen to fail is not a gate (doc 49 SS8's checklist entry, orchestrator ruling 6 of doc 56).

procedure_assertions.PROBE_ONLY: SMOKE PROBE at a REDUCED epoch budget (6). The procedure assertions below are enforced at THIS budget so the code path is exercised cheaply; the registered budgets (450 for R-budget, 75/75/75 for R-layerwise) are enforced on every real run and their arithmetic is asserted separately in `block_partition`.

budget.formula: lr(e) = 0.02 * 0.5 * (1 + cos(pi * (e - 1) / 450)), e = 1..450 -- torch CosineAnnealingLR(T_max=450, eta_min=0) semantics stepped once per epoch, no restarts. PINNED IN exp72_run.py because doc 58 SS6.1 registers the schedule and not the formula.
budget.bundled_intervention_doc58_SS6_1_1: R-budget changes TWO things -- the epoch count AND the lr schedule (the committed loop is constant-lr Adam). A rescue licenses 'the committed recipe undertrained this instance' and does NOT license a decomposition into budget-versus-schedule; that decomposition is NOTED, NOT RUN (doc 58 SS13 item 3).

identity.note: doc 58 SS6.2.2: the readout init is UNCHANGED and the noise is drawn from a DEDICATED stream, so every committed draw the readout consumes is bit-identical to the committed recipe's.

procedure_assertions.PROBE_ONLY: SMOKE PROBE at a REDUCED epoch budget (2). The procedure assertions below are enforced at THIS budget so the code path is exercised cheaply; the registered budgets (450 for R-budget, 75/75/75 for R-layerwise) are enforced on every real run and their arithmetic is asserted separately in `block_partition`.

layerwise.note: doc 58 SS6.3.2, STATED BOTH WAYS AND NEITHER QUOTED ALONE: raw epochs 6 = 0.04x the committed 150; parameter-update-weighted budget 4.000 = EXACTLY the baseline 150. The guard that makes the raw excess non-fatal is registered in advance: R-budget runs at 3.00x in the same units, so a R-layerwise rescue while R-budget does not rescue CANNOT be attributed to the extra 1.5x of epochs.
layerwise.adaptation_clause_doc58_SS4_2: R-layerwise is an ADAPTATION of arXiv:2006.14904, not a replication. Skolik et al. GROW the circuit; exp72's depth is FIXED by the instance, so this arm implements the paper's other mechanism -- training parameter subsets with the complement frozen. A NULL ON THIS ARM IS NOT A NULL ON THEIR PUBLISHED PROCEDURE.
